## Final filtered recommendation batch

Survey basis. The dedicated worktree is clean and current with origin/main at fcc740dba9b076c2089a41b321bd0b736de09d83. No project file changed during the survey. The independent filters completed. alamode-greasy-jerboa and deft-intangible-xanclomys are closed, so their landed work is excluded.

- F21. Defect. docs/jira-sync-setup.md says project selection is optional and that create falls back to DIG. Current reconciliation requires explicit project selection. Remediation. Require an explicit Jira project and describe store-owned project mappings. History. talismanic-profitable-isopod, vein-acid-navy, unworldly-narrow-iggypops, and ADR 0097. Exclusions. Preserve DIG as a valid explicit project and preserve legacy migration behavior. Do not perform a wider rollout-history rewrite. Verification. Compare the guide with configuration resolution and project-selection tests.
- F22A. Defect. scripts/jira-onboarding-reference describes onboarding as planned after bridge setup and jira-onboard shipped. It has no inbound references. Remediation. Delete the obsolete reference helper directory. History. peal-agony-lumen retained it until onboarding existed. vein-acid-navy delivered onboarding. Exclusions. Preserve the maintained onboarding commands and guides. Verification. Confirm no inbound references and run focused onboarding documentation checks.
- F22B. Defect. Both scripts/jira-pressure-test probes default to the deleted src/rebar/_engine/rebar path, substitute DIG, and invoke ambient Python. Remediation. Use the checkout virtual environment, require explicit project selection and mutation opt-in, and add a nonmutating preflight. Preserve supported overrides and waxy-shunt-sty behavior. Exclusions. Do not connect these probes to CI or run mutating probes during verification. Verification. Use shell checks, stubbed command tests, and the nonmutating preflight.
- F24. Defect. docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md correctly calls for fsck after import, but its checklist calls for validate. Remediation. Change the checklist to fsck and retain validate as the separate semantic health operation. History. lunar-senile-poodle and hexametral-peppery-wasp. Exclusions. Do not broaden the connector-limited import workflow. Verification. Check the guide against the fsck and validate command contracts.
- F25. Defect. docs/exit-codes.md documents only raised retryable LLM failures for exit 11. Completion verification also returns 11 when the framework produces verdict_obtainable=false. Remediation. Document both completion paths in the current contract table. History. thin-broadish-basenji established the result-marked path. ADR 0040 owns exit 11. Exclusions. Keep decision chronology in the ticket and ADR. Verification. Run focused exit-code and completion-verifier tests.
- F27. Defect. Public mutation wrappers unlink, tag, untag, archive, and compact lack client-facing documentation after the library surface split. Remediation. Add precise docstrings and reuse-surface entries covering signatures, effects, errors, repository selection, and side effects. Remove stale shell-history narration where it obscures current behavior. History. bloated-shadeful-lamprey. Exclusions. Do not change mutation behavior or duplicate implementation steps. Verification. Run public API, reuse-surface, lint, and type checks.
- F28A. Defect. infra/runbooks/github-mirror-lock.md says GitHub Issues and GitHub Actions should be disabled. GitHub Issues is the intake path, and GitHub Actions supplies the Verified vote. Remediation. Correct the mirror posture while preserving Gerrit-only merging. History. pave-rim-ghost and acardiac-clotty-hornbill. Exclusions. Do not reopen the Gerrit residency decision or mutate repository settings. Verification. Compare the runbook with current workflows and repository configuration.
- F32. Defect. docs/concurrency.md attributes current invariants to deleted ticket shell writers. Remediation. Replace those citations with maintained Python store and command symbols. History. adult-oxide-slave. Exclusions. Preserve the concurrency contract and avoid a prose rewrite. Verification. Confirm every cited path and symbol exists and run focused concurrency documentation checks.
- F33. Defect. docs/migrations.md understates the nine-unit registry, says the ensure sweep never raises although StoreIncompatibleError escapes it, and blurs the implemented compatibility record with the unimplemented ordered ledger. Remediation. Correct those three contracts only. History. nutbrown-catatonic-whale, indigoid-flirty-catbird, and savvy-fawning-chimpanzee. Exclusions. Do not redesign migrations or claim that the ordered ledger exists. Verification. Compare the guide with REGISTRY_IDS, compatibility code, and focused migration tests.
- F34A. Defect. ADR 0042, ADR 0047, and ADR 0091 retain cross references to obsolete ADR numbers after renumbering. Remediation. Correct the affected identifiers and links. History. enthroned-lemony-muskrat. Exclusions. Preserve accepted statuses, supersession banners, decision substance, and explicit renumbering history. Do not introduce an ADR metadata schema or shared generated index. Verification. Run ADR number and link checks and inspect the three diffs.
- F37. Defect. jira_family/sanitizers.py and jira_family/outbound_mapper.py still describe Jira Data Center as a future backend although it is implemented. Remediation. Correct only those module and symbol descriptions to describe the current Cloud and Data Center adapters. History. adroit-deductible-kakapo, ADR 0055, and ADR 0083. Exclusions. No behavior change and no repository-wide comment cleanup. Verification. Run the Jira family boundary tests, lint, and type checking.
- F43A. Defect. src/rebar/_mcp_auth.py says only the static verifier ships and describes the other configured strategies as unimplemented. Static, JWT, introspection, proxy, and custom strategies are implemented. Remediation. Correct the module and exception documentation while retaining fail-closed semantics. History. fixed-jockeyish-swan and ADR 0050. Exclusions. Do not change authentication behavior. Verification. Run focused MCP authentication tests, lint, and type checking.
- F43B. Defect. infra/terraform/modules/sso-gate/README.md links to missing infra/shared/auth/RUNBOOK.md. Remediation. Link to infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md. History. ample-famous-cockatiel. Exclusions. Do not rewrite the SSO architecture. Verification. Confirm the target and run documentation link checks.
- F44. Defect. docs/s3-backend.md and ADR 0093 prescribe rebar config -c, which the parser rejects. Remediation. Document persistent sync.remote selection in project configuration and correct the ADR operational example without changing its decision. History. ADR 0093. Exclusions. Do not change backend selection behavior. Verification. Compare examples with the parser and configuration tests.
- F45. Defect. docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md and infra/runbooks/two-vote-gate-rollback.md describe inactive Verified enforcement, obsolete vote carry, and prior submit behavior. Remediation. Document the active two-vote gate, current TRIVIAL_REBASE carry for both votes, and Rebase If Necessary. History. ADR 0020, ADR 0047, smoky-flare-slug, and hops-air-nub. Exclusions. Preserve rollback and restoration procedures. Verification. Compare both documents with infra/gerrit/project.config and current Gerrit settings without mutating Gerrit.
- F46. Defect. The vendored adjective-adjective-animal license text is absent from distribution license metadata although ADR 0081 requires it. Remediation. Include docs/licenses/adjective-adjective-animal-LICENSE.txt in package license metadata. History. ADR 0081 and dendrological-superhistoric-grizzlybear. Exclusions. Preserve the license text and wordlist bytes. Verification. Build the wheel and source archive, then inspect both contents and metadata.
- F47. Defect. The 2,341-line legacy ticket wordlist has no established upstream revision or license. Import commit b534f47a7f9bf216498bac941a28e9b91c3c3189 names Digital Service Orchestra but provides no source or terms. Remediation. Research pre-extraction history and upstream candidates, record primary-source findings on a ticket, and add a digest guard before any provenance edit. If evidence establishes provenance, file separate attribution and packaging work. History. ADR 0081 covers byte-identical legacy behavior but only attributes the v2 list. Exclusions. Do not alter runtime bytes, guess attribution, infer a license, reuse v2 provenance, or change NOTICE and packaging before evidence exists. Verification. Preserve SHA256 465e54dca65e1fbbb061d77244e6f0d1239d936df1130c0401421b47a0479628 and 2,341 lines, run focused legacy alias tests, and require an exact upstream revision for any later attribution.
- F48. Defect. tests/external/live_jira_dc/Dockerfile names an upstream path but omits the source revision, license identifier, protected license text, and modification statement. Remediation. Record pycontribs/jira commit e3c7b167b065660605645cef7f101cbb324772e4, source path docker/jira-test-image/Dockerfile, BSD-2-Clause, the required license text, and local modifications. History. timid-flattish-upupa. Exclusions. Do not alter Dockerfile instructions or address Atlassian product licensing. Verification. Compare the vendored instructions with the pinned upstream file and run Dockerfile provenance checks.
- F49A. Defect. examples/agent-skills/README.md implies that name and description are both required frontmatter, while the maintained checker requires description and permits name. Remediation. Correct that README statement. History. fruited-fragrant-kitty and paranoiac-gleaming-anhinga. Exclusions. Do not add name to rebar-brainstorm or change the checker. Verification. Run the skill frontmatter checker and its optional-name test.
- F49B. Defect. The package summary in pyproject.toml and MCP registry summary in server.json omit plan review and signed completion verification, although the approved GitHub About now identifies them as distinguishing capabilities. Remediation. Align only those two summaries. History. aimless-seclusive-tigershark. Exclusions. Preserve all other metadata and do not mutate GitHub About. Verification. Validate package metadata, server.json schema, and exact scope.

Held or excluded. F23, F26, F28B, F34B, F35, F36, F39, F40, F41, and F42 remain held. F29, F30, F31, and F38 are complete. F49C is rejected because name is optional. F02, F03, and F04 remain rejected. F05 remains deferred. Mechanical punctuation, character, vocabulary, prose, and comment enforcement remains excluded.
